# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability on **panoskokmotos.com** or in this
repository, please report it **privately** before disclosing it publicly.

**Email:** panos@givelink.app  
**Subject line:** `[SECURITY] <short description>`

Please include:
- A clear description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce
- Potential impact (what an attacker could achieve)
- Any suggested fix (optional but appreciated)

## Response Timeline

| Step | Target |
|---|---|
| Acknowledgement | Within 48 hours |
| Initial assessment | Within 5 business days |
| Fix / mitigation | Within 30 days for critical issues |
| Public disclosure | Coordinated with reporter |

## Scope

**In scope:**
- panoskokmotos.com and its subdomains
- Content and configuration in this repository

**Out of scope:**
- Vulnerabilities in GitHub Pages infrastructure itself (report to GitHub)
- Attacks requiring physical access
- Social engineering
- Denial-of-service attacks
- Issues in third-party services (LinkedIn, GitHub, Givelink — report to them directly)

## Responsible Disclosure

Please give reasonable time to fix the issue before public disclosure.
I commit to acknowledging your contribution and, with your permission,
crediting you in any public disclosure.

Thank you for helping keep this site secure.
